news.title: Investor sentiment improves as stock rises 19%
news.body: After last week's 19% share price gain to ₹14.00, the stock trades at a trailing P/E ratio of 9.8x. Average trailing P/E is 26x in the Hospitality industry in India.

news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 8.0% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risks High level of non-cash earnings (111% accrual ratio). Revenue is less than US$1m (₹73m revenue, or US$783k). Market cap is less than US$10m (₹172.2m market cap, or US$1.85m). Minor Risk Share

news.title: First half 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.88 (vs ₹1.32 in 1H 2025)
news.body: First half 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.88 (down from ₹1.32 in 1H 2025). Revenue: ₹38.8m (down 8.6% from 1H 2025). Net income: ₹9.68m (down 18% from 1H 2025). Profit margin: 25% (down from 28% in 1H 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by lower revenue.
